title: Async files with promises
summary: Read and write files without blocking, using fs/promises with async and await.

quiz.q: Why is readFileSync a poor choice inside a web server that handles many users?
options: While it waits for the disk, the whole program is frozen and no other request can run
It can only read small files
It is not part of Node.js
quiz.explain: Node runs your JavaScript on one thread. A synchronous call blocks that thread, so every other user waits. The promise version lets Node serve others while the disk works.

quiz.q: Complete the function so it waits for the file to be read.
quiz.explain: `await` pauses the async function until the promise finishes and gives you its result. In a CommonJS file it only works inside a function marked `async`.

quiz.q: Which line imports the promise-based file functions?
quiz.explain: `node:fs/promises` gives you the same functions (`readFile`, `writeFile`, ...) but they return promises. `require('node:fs').promises` gives the same functions.

quiz.q: The file a.txt exists. What is printed, in order? Write the two words separated by a space.
quiz.explain: The file is read in the background. The next line runs immediately, so `after` prints first and `read` prints when the file is ready.

exercise.task:
In `files.js`, write three **async** functions with `fs/promises` and export them.

- `wordCount(file)` reads a text file and resolves to the number of words in it (words are separated by spaces or new lines).
- `readJson(file)` reads a JSON file and resolves to the parsed object.
- `writeLines(file, lines)` writes an array of strings to a file, one per line, with a newline after each, and resolves when done.

The folder contains `story.txt` and `config.json` to try your code on.
hints: Import `fs/promises` and mark each function `async`. Inside use `await fs.readFile(file, 'utf8')`.
For words: `text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length`. For JSON: `JSON.parse(text)`. For writing: `await fs.writeFile(file, ...)`. Do not forget to export all three.

the quick brown fox
jumps over the lazy dog
